title: Lemon-Lime-Garlic Orecchiette with Air-Fried Salmon and Broccoli
equip: Air fryer, pasta pot, stainless steel skillet

items.n: salmon fillet, skin on, cut into 3 portions
items.sub: Barramundi or seabass fillet, air fry 1–2 min less

steps.x: Toss florets with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper. Air fry at 200°C for 4 min. Shake the basket and air fry another 4–5 min until the edges are charred. Set aside.

parts.x: Toss florets with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper. Air fry at 200°C for 4 min.
Shake the basket and air fry another 4–5 min until the edges are charred. Set aside.

steps.x: Pat salmon dry, season both sides. Air fry skin-side down at 200°C for 8–10 min, no need to flip, until it just flakes at the thickest part. Set aside.
While the air fryer runs, bring a big pot of well-salted water to the boil. Cook the orecchiette until al dente, about 10–11 min. Reserve 150ml pasta water before draining.

parts.x: While the air fryer runs, bring a big pot of well-salted water to the boil.
Cook the orecchiette until al dente, about 10–11 min. Reserve 150ml pasta water before draining.

steps.x: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in the skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and lime zest. Sauté 30–45 sec until fragrant, not browned.
Add drained pasta and broccoli with a splash of pasta water. Toss over low heat 1–2 min, adding more water for a light glossy coating. Stir in lime juice off the heat.
Stir through parsley. Plate, flake the salmon over and mix through. Chilli flakes and parmesan on adult portions; keep the child's plain.

notes: Salmon doneness: 50–52°C internal for just past translucent.
Freeze leftover salmon in 200g portions, wrapped tight, up to 3 months.
Broccoli first, salmon second; salmon is better fresh out of the air fryer.
If the child dislikes visible garlic, strain it out of the oil before tossing.
